fields.what_it_is: SpineMask Non-Invasive Tracker: Non-invasive patient tracking. SpineMap 3D Software: Offers intra-operative flexibility, intra-operative virtual k-wire and pedicle screw planning, enhanced navigation experience with user-defined views and workflows. Stryker KWIC Needle: Manual surgical instrument intended to be used in spine surgery to facilitate placement of guidewires, may also be used to aspirate autologous blood or bone marrow by use of a syringe.
fields.indications: Stryker KWIC Needle: Indicated for any medical condition in which the use of image guided surgery may be appropriate, and where a reference to a rigid anatomical structure, such as the skull or vertebra, can be identified relative to medical images.
fields.compatible_with: SpineMask: Compatible with a wide variety of imaging devices. SpineMap 3D Software: Compatible with a variety of intra-operative imaging devices for automatic registration.
fields.use_notes: SpineMask: Enables minimally invasive approaches for pedicle screw placement, seamless OR integration. SpineMap 3D Software: Automatic registration, intra-operative virtual k-wire and pedicle screw planning, user-defined views and workflows. Stryker KWIC Needle: May be used as part of a planning and intraoperative guidance system to enable open or percutaneous image guided surgery, the blood or bone marrow may be combined with bone graft or bone void filler.
